title_zh: TCL：从磁带工厂到科技集团
title_en: Chinese Companies (19/20): TCL, from Cassette Factory to Tech Group
note_en: 只有 before a number stresses how small an amount is: 员工只有几十个人 "it had only a few dozen employees." Notice that Chinese needs no verb "to have" here: 只有 itself carries the meaning "there are only." Compare 只是 in the same sentence, 公司最早只是生产磁带的小工厂 "at first the company was just a small factory," where 只是 means "merely, just" and limits the whole description.
